mapper.select: SELECT T.T_CODE, T.T_NAME, T.T_STADIUM, T.T_VIC, T.T_DRAW, T.T_LOSE, T.T_INTRO FROM USER U, TEAM_MANAGEMENT TM, TEAM T WHERE U.U_CODE=TM.U_CODE and TM.T_CODE=T.T_CODE AND TM.TM_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND U.U_CODE = #{u_code};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TEAM(T_NAME, T_STADIUM, T_INTRO, T_VIC, T_DRAW, T_LOSE) VALUES(#{t_name}, #{t_stadium}, #{t_intro}, 0, 0, 0)
INSERT IGNORE INTO TEAM_MANAGEMENT(U_CODE, T_CODE, TM_ROLE, TM_STATUS) VALUES(#{u_code}, #{t_code}, #{role}, 'APPROVED')
